nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Inputs: all Invoke Model fields + pass-through for Post Reply (reviewer_user_id, triggering_comment_id, web_sources) + image_blocks_json (input image refs, ADR-036 Block 5). image_blocks_json doubles as the resolver's input_image_refs_json (Block 12).

nodes.name: Call Invoke Model
nodes.notes: onError=continueErrorOutput so LLM failures route to local Reset+Alert instead of errorWorkflow with no task context. Drafting call returns completion = output-block-list JSON (Block 12).

nodes.name: Parse Output Blocks
nodes.notes: Tolerant parse completion -> output_blocks_json. Strips a ```json fence, falls back to first [...] substring, then to a single {type:text,md:completion} block. Unify-risk safety net (malformed JSON -> renders as prose, never raw JSON, never a crash).

nodes.name: Call Image Resolver
nodes.notes: Block 12: turns the output-block list into {image_manifest, rendered_delta, total_image_cost_pln, image_models, warnings}. input_image_refs_json = input image refs (image_blocks_json, now carrying source_ref) for embed_input resolution. NO onError: a resolver throw is a genuine stage failure -> propagates to the orchestrator's global Error Handler (CRITICAL + status rollback, ADR-025 reactive layer), no partial post. Internal failures (gen/embed/ceiling) come back as warnings, not throws. Runs BEFORE Sum Task Cost so image_gen agent_runs rows are counted.

nodes.name: Has Warnings?
nodes.notes: Block 12: resolver returned >=1 warning (embed-miss / gen-failed / count-ceiling) -> WARN. true -> Alert Resolver Warnings -> Return; false -> Return. Mutually exclusive at runtime so Return LLM Result fires once.

nodes.name: Alert Resolver Warnings
nodes.notes: WARN for per-image gen failure / embed-ref miss / count-ceiling drop (resolver warnings[]). Non-blocking: reconverges into Return LLM Result; the comment still posts with the resolver's placeholder ops.

value.message: Resolver obrazów zgłosił ostrzeżenia — komentarz opublikowano z zastępnikami dla problematycznych bloków.

nodes.name: Return LLM Result
nodes.notes: Block 12: returns text attribution (completion/model/cost_pln) + resolver outputs (rendered_delta, image_manifest, image_models, total_image_cost_pln) + Post Reply pass-through. Sole branch-free terminal.

nodes.name: Reset Status on Failure
nodes.notes: Clears [AI] Status agenta when Invoke Model fails — prevents task stuck at 'W trakcie'.

nodes.name: Alert Invoke Model Failed
nodes.notes: CRITICAL alert when the LLM call fails.

value.message: Wywołanie modelu LLM nie powiodło się — agent nie ukończył zadania.
value.details: =task={{ $('When Called').first().json.clickup_task_id }}; error={{ ($json.error && $json.error.message) || JSON.stringify($json.error) || 'unknown' }}; jeśli 429/cooldown: zrestartuj LiteLLM: cd /opt/haxe-agents && docker compose restart litellm

nodes.name: Call Write Cost Field
nodes.notes: Bare lane cost write-back, now via the shared Write Cost Field (v1) sub-workflow (unification: both lanes write CU '[AI] Koszt akcji [PLN]' through ONE path). Runs AFTER Call Image Resolver so the SUM includes per-generate image_gen rows. The sub-workflow is internally fail-soft (WARNs + returns on DB/CU error); onError=continueRegularOutput here too so a cost-sync hiccup never blocks Return LLM Result. The comment footer still uses the per-run cost (Invoke Model) via Return LLM Result, unchanged.
